note: The dependency-blocker graph seed. Stage order comes from .agent/verification/GRAPH.md PARSED AT RUN TIME; ownership comes from the registry default_stage column through the plan mapping, with the one multi-stage value split per id from its title and every such decision listed in split_decisions. Blocker edges are added by the stages themselves as they run: an id that is BLOCKED_PREREQUISITE must name the edge it waits on, which scripts/harness-validate.sh refuses to accept without.
